messages:
emily: Heads-up 3: prepping the docs relnotes for Monday deploy. Need: 3 short whats-new bullets, SDK snippet refresh, and a concise known-issues list. Who can pick items?

chris: I9ll write the whats-new bullets. Will keep each to one line + one short sentence.

sam: I9ll update SDK snippets. Plan: convert old `client.create_completion()` to `client.responses.create()` and add a streaming example using `client.responses.stream()`.

lee: I9ll assemble known issues + repro steps. Current items: embeddings drift >1024 tokens and occasional model-fallback delays in eu-west.

emily: Great. Chris, phrase bullets customer-first (e.g., "Lower streaming latency for short replies"). Sam, add migration note: `on_token` handlers deprecated.

sam: Draft snippet (python): ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
for chunk in client.responses.stream(model="kestrel-3", prompt="Write a micro poem"):
    print(chunk.text, end="")
```

chris: Posted bullets to PR #824: 1) Faster streaming for short outputs; 2) Updated embed quality profile; 3) SDK migration notes for v1.

docs-bot: Docs preview ready for branch `relnotes/2113334444` (build 523): https://docs-preview.internal.redwood.ai/relnotes-2113334444 :white_check_mark:

lee: Known-issues draft: "Embeddings can show reduced similarity for inputs >1024 tokens. Workaround: truncate to 1024 or pin quantization to `q4_0`." Also note: "eu-west model fallback may add ~200-500ms cold-starts; pin region in route config if SLA-critical."

emily: Add a tiny migration snippet in the relnotes: `create_completion` -> `responses.create()` and remove `on_token` callbacks. Also run the link-checker for old SDK docs paths.

sam: Running grep replace locally: `grep -R "docs.redwood.ai/sdk" -l | xargs sed -i 's|docs.redwood.ai/sdk|docs.redwood.ai/sdk/v1|g'`. Will push after preview passes.

docs-bot: Link checker report: 2 stale SDK links found in branch. See /tmp/linkcheck-523.txt.

emily: Lee, can you patch those anchors? If all green, aim to merge by 10pm PT so publish automation picks up the release.

chris: Tone pass done. Marketing co-sign line added.

sam: Merging snippet PR after docs preview. Will tag SDK repo to sync examples.

emily: Thanks all 1 :tada: - ping me if anything blocks.
